name: Nogi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nogi town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised tree, like an arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Nogi, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 9 March 1973; the emblem dates from 1 February 1973.

features.role: Nogi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised tree, like an arrowhead
